name: kldload workspace keys
description: Adds 'move this window to workspace N and follow it there' — the one half of the workspace keymap GNOME cannot bind natively. Sending a window without following is already possible with the stock move-to-workspace-N bindings; going with it is not, because mutter only activates the target workspace for the relative/directional variants, which cannot express an absolute compass layout. Shell-version range covers the ESM extension format (GNOME 45+) through 50; every API it touches — Main.wm.addKeybinding, workspace_manager.get_workspace_by_index, window.change_workspace, workspace.activate_with_focus — has been stable across that whole range. Verified loading on 48 (Debian trixie) and 50 (Fedora).
